notes: Six-hour agent timeout (override_timeout_sec=21600) on the fixed-QEMU TB2.1 snapshot (evalstate/terminal-bench-2-1@75f5a2e); a modified evaluation, not a leaderboard-eligible configuration.

Run on HF Jobs (cpu-upgrade sandboxes, capacity-matched rather than strictly CPU/RAM-enforced) through the harbor-hf command agent with fast-agent-mcp 0.10.24. Zero whole-trial retries; fast-agent's own provider retries apply.

No cost was recorded at run time; cost is computed from token counts and is a lower bound. Two trials (git-leak-recovery, path-tracing-reverse) are missing usage for one failed stream attempt each, and video-processing__2uf3afv compacted its history (175 messages) and recorded no usage for the calls before compaction.

Review coverage: every pass is cleared except video-processing__2uf3afv, whose history before compaction was archived inside the sandbox, never collected, and can't be reviewed. Images the agent saw were transcribed with codexresponses.gpt-6-luna (reasoning medium) for the recall checks.
